page.overview:
Who is Vastari?

Vastari was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Vastari was employed in the Carthag ampitheater on the day that Argus Veer was due to fight. He was assigned to deliver some Spice to Veer, but was delayed due to how busy it was in the upper parts of the ampitheater. Once he arrived in Veer's quarters, his page Pollux asked him what had happened to Valentin. Vastari was unfamiliar with the name, but apologised and explained the reason for his lateness. Finding Veer unconscious, Vastari suggested waking him with a bucket of water, only for Pollux to inform him that Veer was dead.
